integration: The parent process performs the governed five-condition replacement invocation and actual RuntimeMaintenanceSurfaces World-State/epistemic/self-model composition, then appends developmental history.

A fresh Python interpreter reconstructs PersistentEpistemicStateOwner plus its mutation-receipt controller, LongitudinalSelfModelOwner, and ResidentDevelopmentalCognitionOwner from disk, and performs the later tick.

Only JSON-serialized bounded source record and explicit custody roots cross the process boundary. Child asserts recovered epistemic state IDs/digests and self-model reconciliation ID/digest match pre-restart values; later cognition retrieves the prior developmental record and consumes both recovered projections.

The source record itself is handed to the child in serialized form; the test does not prove a separate durable World-State source-record publisher/reader process handoff. Resource ledger/invocation recovery and production running-process identity remain separate limitations.
